design_decisions.v4_2026_08_08_redesign: STATE MACHINE (Huong 2) - single source of truth cho trips/charging/telemetry. 4 states MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE theo thoi gian -> disjoint by construction (overlap = 0 ve mat logic).
design_decisions.state_machine: DRIVING_PASSENGER (trip co khach) | DEADHEAD (chay khong khach) | IDLE (do cho) | CHARGING (sac). generate_vin_day_states() deterministic per (vin, day_idx) - dam bao telemetry/charging/trips cung share 1 schedule.
design_decisions.telemetry: FULL FLEET (PILOT_SIZE=60): synthetic 15-min/sample cho 60 VIN x 15 days x 96 samples/day = 86,400 rows. VED 20 xe lam per-vehicle distribution reference cho speed/RPM/SOC/voltage/current (cache qua ved_calibration.json). Speed > 0 CHI trong DRIVING_PASSENGER/DEADHEAD, = 0 trong IDLE/CHARGING. SOC physical: giam khi DRIVING*, tang khi CHARGING, stable khi IDLE. Cot state_at_sample cho bi state tai moi sample timestamp. Operating window cap 18:00 (truoc next overnight 18:00+) -> disjoint guarantee.
design_decisions.trips: Tier S: driver_id deterministic DRV_XANH_<SEQ> tu VIN. Pool 25,003 trips tu fact_rides phan bo vao state machine's DRIVING_PASSENGER slots. TRIPS_PER_VIN_PER_DAY=14 (~12h operating window, target 14 trip, actual mean ~11.4 do DEADHEAD/IDLE chen). pickup/dropoff lay tu schedule, sequential + 5min buffer enforced boi state machine.
design_decisions.charging: State machine place: overnight (priority 1, [18:00 prior_day, 06:00 day_idx]) + next_overnight (priority 1, [18:00 day_idx, 06:00 next_day]) + 0-1 opportunity (priority 2, [10:00, 15:00]). 1,290-1,350 sessions/15days (900 overnight + 390-450 opportunity). ACN pool subset theo duration tier. soft_overlap_flag luon False (state machine guarantees disjoint).
design_decisions.cross_domain_consistency: All 3 datasets (trips/charging/telemetry) consume SAME generate_vin_day_states() output. Deterministic seed = hash((vin, day_idx)) % 2^31 -> reproducible cross-function.
design_decisions.fare_currency: Da xac minh USD (Kaggle Ride Hailing Transaction), da quy doi sang VND (x 25400). Tier RD.
